mods.description: Renders the mermaid blocks of the model's replies with an installed mmdc after each turn and draws each picture under its reply.

mods.name: disk-janitor
mods.description: Measures the build artifacts of the repository, shows them on the status line from 5 GB, and deletes the ones you pick in the /disk-janitor pane; data directories are never listed.

mods.name: doc-drift-watch
mods.description: After each commit the model makes, adds the doc lines that commit made stale (file:line references, symbol names) to the commit's result, from ripwire doc-drift, and holds each finding open until the doc holds again.

mods.name: edit-loop
mods.description: Adds a note to the fifth edit of one file in one turn, so the model re-reads the code path and states the root cause instead of trying again.

mods.name: effort-auto
mods.description: Has a small model rate how hard each prompt is and runs that turn and its subagents at the matching effort, within the levels you allow, on the models whose prompt cache survives an effort change.

mods.name: env-sync
mods.description: After each commit the model makes, names the env variables its added lines read that .env.example lacks, with the file and line of each.

mods.name: error-poke
mods.description: Sends one continue prompt after a turn an API error killed, so the half-done work carries on instead of the session going idle, at most 99 times in a row by default.

mods.name: flaky-memory
mods.description: Remembers which tests failed on which code, and tells the model when a failing test has both passed and failed on the same code, so it runs the test again instead of changing code.

mods.name: gemini-advisor
mods.description: Gives the model a Gemini advisor tool it calls by itself: Gemini reads the whole conversation and the model's message and answers with a second opinion. Off until /gemini-advisor on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

mods.name: gemini-compact
mods.description: Moves compaction from Claude to Gemini: in summary mode Gemini summarizes the conversation and the newest messages stay verbatim, in prune mode every message stays and Gemini keeps, cuts or drops older tool calls. Off until /gemini-compact on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking lev…

mods.name: gemini-core
mods.description: Keeps the Gemini keys and tier of every Gemini mod, and each mod's model and thinking level, in one place: adds $.gemini, which builds their Gemini requests, reads the answers and moves to the next key after a quota or key error, and picks a model from Google's list.

mods.name: gemini-plan-review
mods.description: Has Gemini review each plan before the approval dialog, from the plan and the conversation, and sends a plan with a blocking finding back to the model, at most twice. Off until /gemini-plan-review on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

mods.name: gemini-review
mods.description: Has Gemini review every git commit the model runs, from the staged diff and the conversation, and stops a commit with a blocking finding: a bug, data loss, a security hole or a committed secret. Off until /gemini-review on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

mods.name: git-commit
mods.description: Ships a commit skill and holds every Bash git commit to it: a commit the skill did not open, a blanket git add, a signature trailer, a secret, an ignored path, or a push or branch change nobody asked for is stopped before git runs.

mods.name: i18n-watch
mods.description: After an edit that calls translation keys, names the keys the JSON, Laravel PHP, YAML or gettext locale files lack, and the languages that lack them.

mods.name: idle-art
mods.description: Draws an ASCII animation above the prompt while the model works: matrix rain, fire, an aquarium, a cat, or a GIF of your own imported as a character clip for every project. Display only: nothing reaches the model.

mods.name: limit-watch
mods.description: Shows the subscription usage limits under the prompt or in the shared sidebar with a reset countdown and a projection, opens a /limit-watch pane, logs once when a limit passes 80% and 95%, and stops sampling entirely with /limit-watch off.

mods.name: lockfile-sync
mods.description: After each commit the model makes, names the manifests whose dependencies it changed without their lockfile (npm, Composer, Cargo, Go, Python, Bundler, Dart, Mix).

mods.name: mcp-doctor
mods.description: Tells you when an MCP server failed to connect or dropped, with the engine's reason and a reconnect button, and when it is back; claude.ai connectors are left out.

mods.name: memory-save
mods.description: Loads MEMORY.md into the session and saves project learnings to it after every turn through a tool-less fork in the background, without blocking the stop.

mods.name: mod-doctor
mods.description: Names each installed plugin, of every marketplace, whose local clone already offers a newer version, with the claude plugin update command that closes the gap.

mods.name: orphan-server
mods.description: Lists the servers a Bash call of the model started in this repository and left listening on a port, with their age and session, and stops one with SIGTERM, then SIGKILL.

mods.name: output-flood
mods.description: Measures how much context each Bash command spent and tells the model, past a size limit, which narrower command would have answered the same question.

mods.name: pin-note
mods.description: Keeps the notes you pin with /pin-note for the whole session and sends them to the model again, word for word, after each compaction and /clear. Off until /pin-note on.

mods.name: probe-runner
mods.description: For mod development: runs a live check of plugins in a fresh Claude Code session in tmux, types the steps one by one, collects the pane and the transcript, then deletes the temp directory, its transcripts and the inline store files.

mods.name: prompt-deck
mods.description: Learns the short prompts you send often in this project and draws them, with the ones you pin by hand, above the prompt; with the prompt box empty, a digit key sends one at once.

mods.name: prompt-offload
mods.description: Writes a prompt longer than the limit (2000 characters by default) to a temp file and sends the model its first 200 characters with the path, so one paste does not fill the context.

mods.name: prompt-time
mods.description: Draws the time under each of your messages and each text block of the model's replies, also for a resumed session whose transcript is 4 MiB or smaller. Display only: nothing reaches the model.

mods.name: sage-memory
mods.description: Keeps project and global memories in SQLite through a shared local daemon, hands the model the entries that match its file tool calls, prompts and subagent tasks, and saves new ones with a haiku consolidator after each main-loop turn.

mods.name: self-command
mods.description: For mod development: lets the model run a slash command in its own session, such as /reload-plugins after a plugin update, and read the output as the next prompt.

mods.name: session-watch
mods.description: Shows this session's state in the sidebar: context fill, token totals, cost, model and effort, the Claude Code version, the other sessions of this machine, and the git branch and status.

mods.name: shot-inline
mods.description: Draws each PNG or JPG the model saves or reads under its tool row: pixels in kitty and Ghostty, quadrant block cells in every other terminal.

mods.name: sidebar
mods.description: Opens one shared pane beside the transcript and draws the sections, lines and buttons every other mod writes into it through $.sidebar; each stream entry is stamped with its time and kept in a per-project log the next session takes back.

mods.name: slash-chain
mods.description: Runs slash commands joined with && one after another, waits for each command's turn, pane or dialog to end, and stops the chain at a command that failed or a turn that ended without an answer.

mods.name: sql-concat-watch
mods.description: After an edit that builds SQL by joining or interpolating strings, names each line, so the model passes the values as query parameters.

mods.name: storage-guard
mods.description: After an edit that keeps browser data in localStorage or sessionStorage, names each line, so the model stores the data in a cookie instead.

mods.name: subagent-ledger
mods.description: Shows each subagent of the session with its turns, time, model and tokens, the costliest first, yellow while it runs and green once it answered, and marks one that passed the token limit.

mods.name: task-poke
mods.description: Submits a continue prompt while the task list has unfinished tasks, at most 99 times in a row by default, and turns the task tools on for every model unless CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS is set.

mods.name: tool-coach
mods.description: Stops the model from repeating a tool call that just failed with the same input, until a file or command has changed something.

mods.name: ua-fallback
mods.description: After a curl or wget an automated-client filter answered 403 or 429, gives the model the browser User-Agent to retry with, and the two cases where it must not.

mods.name: open-todos
mods.description: Side pane listing unfinished and in-progress todos from all Claude Code sessions, grouped by project

mods.name: token-usage
mods.description: 5h / 7d usage, token totals and cost pills above the prompt

mods.name: cueloop

mods.name: token-ledger

mods.description: Usage tracking for Claude Code: 5-hour and weekly quota left, context, session cost, run-out forecast, saving tips, 7-day history and shared themes for every mod. French or English.

mods.name: clubhouse
mods.description: Claude Clubhouse: a toolbar above the prompt, rooms for usage, agents, commands, tool rules and colors, and whole-window themes on macOS

mods.name: jev-router
mods.description: Asks TypeSafe Jev before each task which Claude model and effort fit best, then runs the turn on it

mods.name: cache-meter
mods.description: Prompt cache status above the prompt: how long the cache stays warm, what a re-cache would cost, plan limits near the cap. Keeps a big cache warm on request and asks before a cold send. The cache part of Nate Herk's cache-keeper.

mods.name: handoff-relay
mods.description: A Handoff button above the prompt: runs /handoff and lights up from 180k tokens of context (the threshold option). Joins cache-meter and next-steps in one band.

mods.name: next-steps
mods.description: A What next? button above the prompt: on press, suggests up to three next prompts; 1, 2 or 3 puts one into the input box as a draft, 0 hides them. A fork of Thariq Shihipar's next-steps, which suggested after every turn.

mods.name: usagemeter
mods.description: A /usagemeter pane with cost, tokens and plan limits across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Antigravity, read from local history and a CLIProxyAPI hub.

mods.name: cache-keeper
mods.description: Prompt-cache countdown, cost to re-warm, usage limits, cold-cache warnings and one-click handoff → clear & continue.

mods.name: firstmate-calm
mods.description: Firstmate Calm for Claude Code: the sailboat working animation and conversation-only transcript presentation, sharing the per-home config/calm preference with the Pi Calm extension. Its hooks module may load through CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS or Claude Code's tengu_plugin_hooks_modules rollo…

mods.name: jev-claude-router
mods.description: Routes each Claude Code turn to the model and effort TypeSafe's Jev picks, weighed against what a switch costs, and compacts with Jev instead of a lossy summary.

mods.name: session-handoff-button
mods.description: A Session Hand-off button above the prompt, colored by context usage; reads Context clean and cannot be pressed while green. From orange on, one press writes the handoff, copies it, runs /clear and sends it to the fresh session.

mods.name: en-cristiano
mods.description: Debajo de cada acción de Claude, una línea en español normal que explica qué está haciendo (leer, crear, mover, borrar, buscar...). Para entender a Claude sin saber informática.

mods.name: mejora-prompts
mods.description: /mejora y una frase: Claude te hace 3-5 preguntas, escribe un prompt con contexto (sin rol), lo puntúa y lo corrige hasta el 9/10, con bucle o sin bucle. Método de diariovida.com.

mods.name: mis-reglas
mods.description: Tu Claude se ve distinto: una franja encima del cuadro de texto con tus reglas activas y el «pensando» en español castizo.

mods.name: modo-grabacion
mods.description: Modo grabación: /grabar oculta en pantalla correos, rutas de usuario, IPs, claves y los nombres que tú elijas, para grabar sin enseñar datos

mods.name: papelera
mods.description: Cuando Claude va a borrar algo, en vez de borrarlo lo manda a una papelera (~/.papelera-claude) para que puedas recuperarlo. /papelera te enseña qué hay dentro.

mods.name: installguard
mods.description: Looks up every new package before it installs: holds made-up names, typosquats, days-old releases and curl-into-shell for your answer, and lets the rest through.

mods.name: mod-store
mods.description: /mods: browse, search and install community Claude Code mods from a pane, with what each one can access shown before you install

mods.name: youtube-side-player
mods.description: Watch YouTube videos on the side in any screen or terminal position while working in Claude Code

mods.name: clean-view
mods.description: Clean View: hides tool calls and shows a calm step checklist above the prompt, with a Hide/Show details button.

mods.name: speaker-colours
mods.description: Herman's Claude Code mod: blue speaker bar for user messages, orange for Claude replies (more features to come)

mods.name: team-orchestrator
mods.description: Team Orchestrator: welcome screen, quick starts (Squad, All-Purpose Team, Tech Team), a table-style team form, and a live roster to spawn and manage teams of Claude Code sessions as Orca tabs.

mods.name: CommitNudge
mods.description: A quiet reminder in the status line and a toast when uncommitted work piles up in the chat's project

mods.name: MacLoad
mods.description: Shows your Mac's CPU and memory under the prompt, names the app behind a slowdown, and warns when the Mac is overloaded

mods.name: Runway
mods.description: Your Claude Code 5-hour and weekly limits and the chat’s context window as live meters above the prompt

mods.name: UsageBreakdown
mods.description: Shows what uses up your Claude limits: tokens by model, by main chat versus agents, and by project, across every chat on this Mac

mods.name: agent-watch
mods.description: Subagents at a glance: tokens per agent, a toast when one stalls, and a summary naming the heaviest agent when they finish

mods.name: allowlist-coach
mods.description: Counts permission dialogs per rule and, after repeated approvals, offers to add the rule to permissions.allow, asking before it writes

mods.name: launchpad
mods.description: A menu of one-click actions under the header, above the prompt or in a pane, and a control panel from ◆ pad: model and effort in one click, this collection's mods, the shortcuts. Pick and order up to 8 with /pad configuration

mods.name: limits-meter
mods.description: Plan limits and context above the prompt: model and effort, 5-hour and weekly windows with reset times, context fill, cache hit rate, tokens per turn, and a toast on a costly model switch near the limit

mods.name: plain-view
mods.description: A quiet transcript: tool rows step aside and the agent's plan shows as a card above the prompt, with the current step, progress bars and a summary when the turn ends

mods.name: test-hud
mods.description: Test runs at a glance: passing over total in the status line, a sparkline of failures across runs, the failing tests, and a toast when the suite turns green

mods.name: graphos-agent-mods
mods.description: Experimental Claude Code mods for GraphOS Agent Services. GraphOS Inspector explains each execute call in a docked pane before you approve it, shows what came back with clickable records, and can auto-approve the reads you write trust rules for.

mods.name: spindle
mods.description: Turns Claude Code's thinking spinner into a live developer-news ticker, in the CLI and the Desktop app. Headlines are cached locally and tightened by a Claude Code agent — no API keys.

mods.name: extra-mods
mods.description: An extra-mods menu in the bottom corner: Zen mode with a progress band, Claude Code themes from terminalcolors.com, model, effort and permission mode controls and a status line.

mods.name: desktop-statusline
mods.description: Claude desktop の Code タブに、CLI と同じステータスバー (statusline-command.sh の出力) を色つきで出す (issue 625)

mods.name: issue-band
mods.description: 期限切れ・期限が近い human と未決着の retro があるときだけ、プロンプトの上の帯に出す (issue 621)

mods.name: peer-inbox
mods.description: 他セッションとの SendMessage の送受信を、プロンプト直上の帯・toast・status line に残す (transcript が流れても消えない写し)

mods.name: ratelimit-warn
mods.description: Claude の 5h 枠が閾値を超えていたらプロンプトに 1 行注入し、status line にも出す (settings の hook ratelimit-warn.sh の mod 版。issue 658)

mods.name: tool-elapsed
mods.description: 長く走っている tool 呼び出し (codex exec / swift test / make test …) の経過時間をプロンプトの上の帯に出し、5 分ごとに toast で知らせる

mods.name: pokemon
mods.description: Your Pokémon party journeys through a pixel world above the Claude Code prompt: it runs while Claude works, cheers when tests pass, faints when they fail, levels up and evolves.

mods.name: 12ui-design
mods.description: A Design workspace in Claude Code: see design options for a UI as images, select one, ask for more, ask for a change with a note and hand an option off to be built. Your agent runs the 12ui command line once per request, which draws every option at once with your own Codex sign-in.

mods.name: airquote
mods.description: Turns voice-mode dictation into clean, clear prompts: detects which prompts you spoke, then has Haiku remove filler, apply self-corrections and (optionally) restructure them before Claude reads them.

mods.name: sleight
mods.description: Unofficial: lets Claude drive macOS apps in the background through the computer-use engine bundled with the ChatGPT desktop app, without taking over your cursor.

mods.name: workflow-gates
mods.description: Draws the agentic-workflows engine's gates in the band above the prompt — rows a click puts in the prompt and a second click sends — instead of a menu the model has to reproduce.

mods.name: adversarial-review-loop
mods.description: Implement an agreed plan with an enforced adversarial review loop: every phase commit is gated on an external review.

mods.name: prompt-spellcheck
mods.description: Fixes spelling and typos in each typed prompt with a fast model before the main model reads it

mods.name: no-limit
mods.description: Resumes your Claude Code session automatically once the usage limit that stopped it resets

mods.name: familiar
mods.description: A pixel-art companion above the prompt that reacts to your session, levels up, and can be redrawn by hand

mods.name: best-of-n
mods.description: Runs 2-4 attempts at a task in parallel git worktrees, each with a different approach; compare their diffs and adopt the best.

mods.name: bisect
mods.description: Finds the commit that broke something: git bisect with your test command in a temporary worktree (your working tree is never touched), live progress in a pane, the culprit with its diff stat handed to Claude.

mods.name: canvas
mods.description: Gives Claude a screen to draw on: SVG diagrams and Markdown reports in a Canvas pane with history.

mods.name: council
mods.description: More than one mind: ask several models at once and get a synthesis, critique the last answer, and let Claude consult another model.

mods.name: data-peek
mods.description: Look into CSV, TSV, JSON and JSON Lines files without dumping them into context: schema, stats, rows, filters, group counts and single-row lookups, exact and compact, streamed with caps; a /peek pane with column sparklines.

mods.name: gh-inbox
mods.description: GitHub issues and pull requests in a pane — one press to have Claude work on an issue or review a PR — plus the current branch's PR checks in the readout.

mods.name: http-lab
mods.description: An HTTP tool for API work: status, timing, trimmed headers and a body shaped to fit; localhost runs freely, other hosts ask once a session; an /http pane of the session's requests with replay and copy-as-curl.

mods.name: plan-board
mods.description: A live plan Claude posts and keeps current: progress above the prompt, the full checklist and its history in a pane.

mods.name: recall
mods.description: Search this project's past sessions: /recall for you (attach an old exchange to your next prompt), a tool for Claude to look up earlier decisions.

mods.name: repo-map
mods.description: A compact, cached map of the repository for Claude: files by folder with sizes and each source file's symbols with line numbers, sized to a token budget, instead of reading files to get its bearings.

mods.name: slim
mods.description: Shrinks the context without losing the conversation: bulky old tool results become one-line stubs, every message stays word for word.

mods.name: spec-runner
mods.description: Works through a Markdown checklist item by item: one prompt per item, an optional check command, the box ticked when it passes.

mods.name: swarm
mods.description: Splits a task into independent parts, runs them as parallel subagents you launch and watch live, then hands their results back for integration.

mods.name: watchdog
mods.description: Runs your dev server or watcher for the session, flags its errors above the prompt, and lets Claude read its output.

mods.name: auto-retry
mods.description: Keeps long sessions going through API errors and rate limits: resubmits after a backoff when idle, waits out rate limits with a countdown, never loops, and stops the moment you type.

mods.name: ci-autopilot
mods.description: CI that fixes itself with your say-so: watches the branch's workflow run after a push, puts a failure with its error-dense log on the band with Fix it, surfaces new review comments, and can pre-review PRs you are asked to review.

mods.name: daily-brief
mods.description: The first session of your day starts with a briefing: what changed since you left, what waits on you, your work in flight, a first step and a standup draft.

mods.name: dep-sentinel
mods.description: Audits the project's dependencies once a day in the background (npm, pnpm, yarn, pip-audit, cargo audit) and flags high-severity vulnerabilities above the prompt, with details and a one-press safe upgrade by Claude.

mods.name: env-doctor
mods.description: Catches a broken dev environment before Claude trips on it: wrong Node/Python/Go versions, missing node_modules, .env gaps, merges or rebases in progress.

mods.name: follow-ups
mods.description: The things Claude told you to do yourself, never lost: captured from answers, kept per project, mirrored to .claude/follow-ups.md, one press to finish, snooze or hand back to Claude.

mods.name: fresh-start
mods.description: Notices when a session is getting heavy (full context, repeated compactions, slow turns, tool errors), prepares a handoff in the background, and offers a one-press fresh start that continues from it.

mods.name: idle-compact
mods.description: Compacts the conversation while you are away, a few idle minutes in and before the prompt cache goes cold, instead of in the middle of your work.

mods.name: lesson-learner
mods.description: Claude gets better at your project without you writing rules: your corrections and the command errors Claude fixes become one-press lessons for CLAUDE.md.

mods.name: night-shift
mods.description: Works your backlog while you are away: when idle, one worker at a time implements the next .claude/backlog.md task in its own git worktree under a strict tool policy and budget; in the morning you review, adopt or discard each branch.

mods.name: pair-watcher
mods.description: Claude knows what you changed between turns: files edited outside Claude are named (with small diffs) beside your next prompt, and an optional cheap review flags slips in your own edits.

mods.name: test-radar
mods.description: Runs the tests related to each change (Claude's edits and yours) in the background; a failure caused by Claude's edit reaches Claude mid-turn, and the band offers Show and Fix it.

mods.name: auto-context
mods.description: Say "this error", "the tests", "this file", "what you just did" or "the plan" and what it points at goes along with your prompt: the failing output, the test failures, the file, the diff, the plan. No model calls, size-capped, never twice, and Remove takes it back.

mods.name: auto-continue
mods.description: Keeps work flowing: when Claude stops mid-task ("Next I'll…") or asks an obvious yes ("Shall I continue?"), a 5-second countdown you can stop sends a short continue. Never for choices, missing info or risky steps.

mods.name: auto-polish
mods.description: Every prompt you type gets a quiet second read: without changing your words, a hidden note gives Claude the goal in one line, the likely scope, the project's checks to keep green, and what done means. Haiku only for vague prompts; See, Undo and Off in the band.

mods.name: auto-review
mods.description: A quick second pair of eyes after edits: reviews the turn's diff in the background and offers to fix what it finds.

mods.name: loop-breaker
mods.description: Notices when Claude is stuck repeating itself (same failing call, same output, edit flip-flops, failure streaks) and tells it to change approach.

mods.name: queue
mods.description: A prompt queue that runs itself: line up prompts with /queue and they run one after another, pausing when Claude asks you something or a turn fails.

mods.name: rebound
mods.description: Sharper retries after a failed turn: when checks still fail, Claude gives up, errors loop, or you say "that didn't work", haiku drafts a retry with the lesson, a different approach and the exact failing output. One click sends it.

mods.name: verify-loop
mods.description: Runs your project's checks after Claude edits, shows pass/fail above the prompt, and closes the loop with one-press (or automatic, bounded) fixes.

mods.name: mod-manager
mods.description: The Gobworks manager: browse every mod by category, see what each does and costs, turn mods and presets on or off, and check them. Best standalone in any terminal (gobworks); inside a running Claude Code session too (/mods).

mods.name: achievements
mods.description: A little game layer: 32 achievements for how you use Claude Code, with lifetime progress and a /achievements pane.

mods.name: arcade
mods.description: Something to do during long turns: /snake and /2048 in a pane, with high scores and a nudge when Claude is done.

mods.name: gob-pet
mods.description: Gob as a Tamagotchi-style companion who lives off your work: finished turns, green tests and commits grow him, and /pet lets you feed, play with, pet, nap and dress him. Free, and he never punishes you.

mods.name: narrator
mods.description: Opt-in: after a long turn, hear one spoken sentence about what Claude did.

mods.name: notify
mods.description: A chime, a toast and an optional webhook when Claude finishes a long turn or needs your permission.

mods.name: spinner-themes
mods.description: Themed words for the waiting line (pirate, space, kitchen, ...) plus live output speed and step count.

mods.name: timestamps
mods.description: Shows when you sent each prompt ([14:32]) and when each turn finished.

mods.name: jev
mods.description: Jev (TypeSafe's System One model) as Claude's instant co-processor: bulk filter/classify/rank/semantic-grep tools, risk notes under permission dialogs, a check on unverified 'it passes' claims, and optional per-prompt effort.

mods.name: jev-autopermit
mods.description: Opt-in instant approval for clearly harmless shell commands: a strict pre-filter, then Jev classifies the command; only read-only inspection at ≥ 97% with no network risk skips the permission dialog. Every approval is logged.

mods.name: jev-comments
mods.description: No narrating comments: every comment an edit adds is judged by Jev in a few hundred ms; 'Added X as requested' and friends go back to Claude.

mods.name: jev-conventions
mods.description: Instant repo-convention checks on every edit: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, style guides and config facts compiled into atomic rules, each edit judged against all of them by Jev in a few hundred ms.

mods.name: jev-docdrift
mods.description: Docs that went stale because of this turn's changes: changed names, flags, env vars and config keys are looked up in the docs, and Jev reads each section against the new code.

mods.name: jev-express
mods.description: Reflexes: short read-only requests (git status, diff stat, recent commits, cost, context) answered locally in an Express pane, no model turn.

mods.name: jev-judge
mods.description: A definition of done Jev checks after every turn: per-criterion probabilities that demand evidence, a band above the prompt, optional auto-continue.

mods.name: jev-mood
mods.description: Claude adapts to how you are doing: Jev reads each prompt's tone in a blink and, when the signal is strong, hands Claude one hidden line of guidance. Silent by default.

mods.name: jev-ping
mods.description: Notifications only when you are actually needed: after each turn Jev reads whether Claude asks you something, is stuck, or finished a long task; permission prompts ping too. Toast, chime, optional webhook.

mods.name: jev-precommit
mods.description: A commit gate that reads the staged diff in a blink: Jev flags debug output, commented-out code, TODOs, machine paths, secrets and off-message changes before Claude's git commit runs.

mods.name: jev-reuse
mods.description: "This helper already exists": new functions are compared against a git-grep symbol index, Jev judges the look-alikes in a few hundred ms, and Claude hears about duplicates.

mods.name: jev-scope
mods.description: Keeps changes on task: every edit is judged by Jev against your last request (and Claude's plan) in a few hundred ms; drive-by changes go back to Claude.

mods.name: jev-scout
mods.description: Jev ranks every file in the repo against each prompt in ~0.5 s and hands Claude the likely relevant ones (System-1 file triage).

mods.name: jev-seclint
mods.description: An instant security reviewer on every code edit: ~20 yes/no checks per edit answered by Jev in a few hundred ms, fed back to Claude.

mods.name: jev-test-guard
mods.description: Catches tests being weakened to make them pass: every test-file edit is judged by Jev in a few hundred ms against what you asked for.

mods.name: jev-topic
mods.description: Jev notices when a prompt starts an unrelated task and offers a fresh conversation for it, saving context and prompt cache.

mods.name: jev-triage
mods.description: Every failed Bash/PowerShell command gets an instant Jev diagnosis (15 failure classes) and a playbook in this project's terms, as a note Claude reads.

mods.name: jev-trim
mods.description: Huge Bash/PowerShell outputs cut to the lines that matter: Jev scores every 12-line chunk against your request, the full log is saved for Claude to open.

mods.name: compact-keeper
mods.description: Compaction without amnesia: archives the full transcript before each compaction and tells the summarizer to keep paths, decisions, preferences, TODOs and working commands.

mods.name: file-radar
mods.description: What Claude touched this session: reads, edits (+/− lines), searches per file, main vs subagent, with flags for blind edits and repeated reads.

mods.name: git-panel
mods.description: Git at a glance and in reach: a branch/changes readout, a /git pane to diff, stage, revert and commit, and Conventional Commit messages written by haiku.

mods.name: handoff
mods.description: /handoff writes a structured handoff (goal, state, decisions, files, next steps, gotchas, how to verify) to .claude/handoffs/; /handoff load hands it to a later session.

mods.name: journal
mods.description: Project memory across sessions: every few turns haiku writes what was done, decided and left open to .claude/journal.md, and new conversations start with the latest entries.

mods.name: snapshots
mods.description: Whole-tree time travel: a git snapshot of every non-ignored file before each turn, with diff, restore and /undo, never touching HEAD, the index or the stash.

mods.name: clarifier
mods.description: Ask before guessing: when a prompt looks ambiguous, Claude asks up to three clarifying questions first. Off until /clarify on.

mods.name: modes
mods.description: Switchable working styles (teach, terse, pair, review, tdd, explore, ship, or your own) applied to every prompt you send.

mods.name: next-steps
mods.description: One-tap follow-ups: after each answer, three short next prompts above the prompt, on keys 1-3.

mods.name: pins
mods.description: Standing context you control: pin notes and files once, and every prompt you send carries them.

mods.name: prompt-stash
mods.description: Park a half-written prompt, ask something else, and pop it back into the box later.

mods.name: snippets
mods.description: Text expansion in the prompt box: type ;plan and a space, get the full instruction.

mods.name: bash-guard
mods.description: Blocks catastrophic shell commands (rm -rf ~, curl | sh, force-push to main, DROP DATABASE, format C:) and asks before risky ones (git reset --hard, rm -rf, terraform apply), in Bash and PowerShell.

mods.name: branch-guard
mods.description: Keeps work off protected branches: no commit, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, am or push on main/master/release/* (or an explicit push to one), with an optional auto-branch for commits.

mods.name: clobber-guard
mods.description: Stops accidental truncation of real code: no "// ... rest of the code" placeholders over real code, and a question before a Write or Edit throws away most of a file.

mods.name: package-scout
mods.description: Supply-chain check before installs: npm/pnpm/yarn/bun/npx, pip/uv/poetry/pipx, cargo and gem packages are looked up first; nonexistent names are refused, brand-new, unpopular, deprecated or lookalike ones need your yes.

mods.name: path-guard
mods.description: Protected files and a project boundary: Claude can't edit .env, keys or .git, asks before touching lockfiles and migrations, and asks before writing outside the project.

mods.name: readonly-mode
mods.description: "Look, don't touch": /readonly on blocks edits and every command that is not provably read-only, and tells Claude to investigate and explain instead.

mods.name: secret-shield
mods.description: Keeps credentials out of your code, your shell commands and Claude's context: blocks hard-coded secrets in edits, asks before commands with literal keys, redacts secrets from tool results and flags them in prompts.

mods.name: commit-craft
mods.description: Commit messages in your repository's own style (learned from its last 30 subjects) and pull request descriptions from the branch, drafted by haiku; nothing is committed or pushed without a press.

mods.name: haiku-first
mods.description: Opt-in: questions about the codebase (where is, what does, how does, which file, find) go to a read-only haiku scout subagent first; its answer comes with Ask Claude anyway and Good enough, and the tokens saved.

mods.name: live-ticker
mods.description: During long turns, haiku writes one line above the prompt every ~30 s on what Claude is doing and what comes next, from a compact log of its tool calls; a one-line recap toast after turns over two minutes.

mods.name: side-chat
mods.description: A side conversation with haiku or sonnet in a pane, kept out of Claude's context: attach Claude's last answer, the diff, the plan or a file on demand, then send the answer or a summary to the prompt box.

mods.name: test-drafter
mods.description: Opt-in: after a turn that adds or changes functions, sonnet (or haiku) drafts focused unit tests in the background, in the repo's framework and style; Review, Add & run (only that file), or Dismiss; never writes without a press; daily budget cap.

mods.name: cache-lens
mods.description: Prompt-cache hit rate, a live warm/cold countdown, cache-bust alerts with likely causes, savings, and optional keep-warm pings.

mods.name: cost-meter
mods.description: Spend tracking across sessions: session and today's cost in the readout, daily and weekly budgets with toasts and an optional hard stop, and a /spend pane.

mods.name: hud
mods.description: One compact status line: model, context fill, cache hit and warm countdown, session cost, the fullest rate limit, and git branch with changed files.

mods.name: rate-radar
mods.description: Subscription rate limits at a glance: each window and its reset in the readout, toasts at 75% and 90% and when your pace beats the reset, and a /limits pane.

mods.name: tldr
mods.description: A one-line TL;DR under long answers, written by haiku.

mods.name: turn-receipt
mods.description: A receipt for every turn: tools, tokens, cache hits, estimated cost and lines changed, on the turn's closing line (or in the transcript), with a /receipts pane.

mods.name: agent-router
mods.description: Picks the model for each subagent by its type (Explore on Haiku by default) and can cap how many run at once.

mods.name: attribution
mods.description: Your commit and pull request credit line, your way: Claude Code's default, none, or your own template with {model}.

mods.name: autotune
mods.description: Per-prompt effort autopilot: classifies each prompt (Jev, Claude Haiku, or heuristics) and sets that turn's effort, and optionally its model, only when the switch beats the prompt-cache rewrite it causes.

mods.name: cache-guard
mods.description: Asks before /model, /output-style, /fast, /effort, MCP or plugin changes and /config rows that would throw away a warm prompt cache, with the cost of rewriting it; names the rebuilds it could not prevent.

mods.name: delta-reads
mods.description: When Claude re-reads a file that changed since it last read it, it gets only the changed hunks (current line numbers, a few context lines) instead of the whole file.

mods.name: output-trimmer
mods.description: Huge Bash/PowerShell outputs without the context bill: Claude gets the head and tail, the full text goes to a file it can open.

mods.name: paste-shrinker
mods.description: Asks before sending a huge pasted log, stack trace, JSON or CSV: shrink it to a digest (head, tail, error lines) and save the full text under .claude/pastes, or send it as is.

mods.name: read-cache

mods.description: The first six Baselane band meters in one row above the prompt: session cost, lattes, context bar, today's spend, the focus timer and the mood ring.

mods.name: bead
mods.description: Adds /bead <id>: one bead with status, priority, labels, description, blockers and children. Read with bd, the beads tracker. Read-only. Prints only, copies nothing.

mods.name: bead-chime
mods.description: Plays a short chime when a Bash call that ran bd close (or bd done) ends with exit code 0. It reads only the command text and the result, and runs no program.

mods.name: bead-now
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the bead in progress you updated last and how many more are in progress, read with bd list every 2 minutes and after Claude runs bd. Hidden when none is.

mods.name: bead-streak
mods.description: Counts the days in a row you closed a bead, from Bash calls that ran bd close and exited 0. Adds /bead-streak and a toast on a new best. Reads command text only, runs no program.

mods.name: beads-band
mods.description: A band above the prompt with your beads counts (bd 97 ready · 45 active · 29 blocked), read with bd status every 2 minutes and after Claude runs bd. Hidden without bd or a beads project.

mods.name: beads-bars
mods.description: All six beads bands in one row: counts, the bead in progress, epic progress, done percent, closed today and open by priority, read with bd every 2 minutes and after Claude runs bd.

mods.name: beads-guard
mods.description: Asks before bd commands that delete data or rewrite history: delete, purge, prune, gc, sql, admin, import, rename, forget, restore, migrate and more. Reads only the command text, runs no bd.

mods.name: beads-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of your beads: in progress, ready and blocked issues, 10 each, with counts. Read with bd, read-only, after Bash calls. Open it with /beads.

mods.name: beads-prime
mods.description: Runs bd prime once per session and adds its text (max 8 KB) to the system prompt, from the repo's .beads files and bd memories. bd setup claude hooks may add it twice.

mods.name: branch-band
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the git branch and the count of changed files, read with git status after each Bash call and file edit.

mods.name: branches
mods.description: Adds /branches: local branches merged into the default branch or idle for 30 days, as a cleanup list, read with git. Never deletes. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: break-nudge
mods.description: Suggests a short break once the session has run 90 minutes, and again every 90 minutes after that.

mods.name: bullet-mode
mods.description: Replies as short bullet lists, at most one sentence per bullet, unless you ask for code.

mods.name: cache-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the share of prompt tokens the cache served this session (cache 87%). A high share means cheaper, faster turns.

mods.name: changelog
mods.description: Adds /changelog: commits since the last tag (or the last 30), read with git log and grouped by conventional-commit type, as Markdown. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: chmod-guard
mods.description: Asks before chmod makes files world-writable (777, a+w, o+w) or chmod or chown runs recursively on a broad path (/, a system folder, a home folder).

mods.name: ci-band
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the latest GitHub Actions run of your branch (ci passed, ci failed, ci running), asked of the gh CLI every 2 minutes; branch read with git. Hidden without gh.

mods.name: clippy
mods.description: One helpful toast per session per trigger, in the classic paperclip voice: when you edit a migrations folder, a Dockerfile or a GitHub workflow, or run rm -rf. At most one toast per turn.

mods.name: code-only
mods.description: Replies with the code or command first and at most two short sentences of prose, unless asked to explain.

mods.name: commit-msg
mods.description: Adds /commit-msg: a Conventional Commits message proposed from the staged diff, read with git. Heuristic, no model call, writes nothing. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: conflicts
mods.description: Adds /conflicts: tracked files that still hold merge conflict markers, with line numbers, found with git grep. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: cost-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the session cost so far and what the last turn cost.

mods.name: cost-pane
mods.description: A live side pane with the session cost, the cost of each of the last 10 turns as a bar, and the average per turn. Open it with /cost-pane.

mods.name: cron-guard
mods.description: Asks before scheduled jobs or services are wiped or stopped: crontab -r, crontab replaced from stdin or a file, launchctl unload or bootout, systemctl stop, disable or mask.

mods.name: ctx-nudge
mods.description: Reminds you to /clear or /compact when the context window passes 75 percent.

mods.name: daily-spend
mods.description: A band above the prompt with today's total cost across all your sessions.

mods.name: deps
mods.description: Adds /deps: direct dependencies with versions from package.json, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, go.mod and Cargo.toml at the repo root. No network. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: dev-band
mods.description: The developer band in one row above the prompt: git branch and changed files (read with git status), wall clock and session age, tool counts, and failed tool calls.

mods.name: diff-stats
mods.description: Edit and Write rows show a compact +12 -3 bar beside the file name: green for lines added, red for lines removed, up to 20 cells.

mods.name: docs-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast when edits added exported code (an export statement in .ts or .js, or a public function signature) and no README or docs file was edited this session.

mods.name: eli5-mode
mods.description: Explains like the reader is new: analogies first, no jargon without a one-line definition.

mods.name: env-check
mods.description: Adds /env-check: variable names in .env.example against .env at the git repo root, listing missing and extra names. Reads names only, never a value. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: envinfo
mods.description: Adds /envinfo: versions of git, node, npm, python3, go, rustc and docker if installed, by running each (2 s limit), and the OS. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: epic-bar
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the progress of the epic you work on, or of the open epic nearest to done (bm-ooq ███████░ 7/8), read with bd. Hidden without epics or bd.

mods.name: epics-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of each open beads epic: a bar of closed and total children, and a mark when it is ready to close. Read with bd, read-only. Open it with /epics.

mods.name: error-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with how many tool calls failed this session (an error or a deny) and which tool failed last. Red from the first failure.

mods.name: exit-badge
mods.description: A failed Bash row shows a small red badge with its exit code, for example exit 2.

mods.name: file-links
mods.description: In Claude's replies, path/to/file.ts:42 references to files in your project become links. Click one to put @path/to/file.ts in the prompt.

mods.name: file-owners
mods.description: Adds /owners <path>: the top 5 authors of a file or folder by lines, from git blame. Names only, never addresses. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: files-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of the files Claude read, edited or wrote this session, grouped by action with a count per file, newest first. Open it with /files.

mods.name: focus-pack
mods.description: Three quiet nudges in one mod: commit after 8 edits, TODO/FIXME/HACK lines added, and debug prints added.

mods.name: fun-pack
mods.description: Fun habits in one install: caveman prose and gitmoji commit messages. They compose: caveman never touches commit messages.

mods.name: git-pane
mods.description: A live side pane, read with git: the branch, ahead and behind its upstream, changed files (staged and unstaged) and the last 5 commits. Refreshes after git commands and edits. Open it with /git.

mods.name: guard-pack
mods.description: The 15 core Baselane guards in one mod (secrets, git, infra, packages, path jail). Some read git, measure files with find, read HOME with printenv, or check where a path really lands.

mods.name: handoff
mods.description: Adds /handoff: writes a session summary with the git status to .claude/handoff.md (never overwriting) and answers with the path. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: heatmap
mods.description: Adds /heatmap: a 12-week calendar grid of the days you used Claude Code, like a contribution graph, shaded by turns, naming your busiest day.

mods.name: hotspots
mods.description: Adds /hotspots: the 10 files changed most often in the last 90 days, from git log, with change counts. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: infra-guard
mods.description: Asks before terraform destroy, kubectl delete, force-push, DROP TABLE or rm -rf.

mods.name: issue-links
mods.description: #123 references in Claude's replies become links to that issue when the repository's origin is on GitHub or GitLab. Display only.

mods.name: k8s-guard
mods.description: Asks before kubectl apply or replace with --force, kubectl drain, helm uninstall, and kubectl delete behind global flags (plain kubectl delete is infra-guard's).

mods.name: langs
mods.description: Counts the file types Claude edits across sessions and adds /langs: a bar list of the types edited most, each file counted once per session.

mods.name: licenses
mods.description: Adds /licenses: the licence of each direct dependency, from node_modules and Python dist-info at the git repo root. Shows unknown when it cannot tell. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: loc
mods.description: Adds /loc: lines of tracked text files by language, read with git, sorted, with a total. Skips lockfiles and binaries. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: mood-ring
mods.description: A band above the prompt with a colored dot and a word for the error and block rate of your last 20 tool calls: calm (green) under 10 percent, tense (yellow) under 30, stormy (red) from 30.

mods.name: night-owl
mods.description: Records the hour of each prompt across sessions and adds /hours: a 24-hour histogram of when you work, naming your peak hour.

mods.name: no-em-dash
mods.description: Never writes the em-dash character. Uses a comma, colon, period or parentheses.

mods.name: noir-mode
mods.description: Prose like a hard-boiled detective narrator, light and clear. Code, commands, commit messages and error text stay exact.

mods.name: nudge-pack
mods.description: Two turn-end reminders in one mod: test-reminder and ctx-nudge.

mods.name: ops-band
mods.description: The ops band in one row above the prompt: commits ahead and behind the upstream (git), the latest GitHub Actions run of your branch (gh), and the Mac battery (pmset).

mods.name: path-jail
mods.description: Asks before Write, Edit or NotebookEdit changes a file outside the working directory, by real path.

mods.name: pomodoro
mods.description: A band above the prompt with a 25/5 focus timer (focus 18:42, break 03:10). Start and stop it with /pomodoro; a toast marks each switch.

mods.name: port-watch
mods.description: A live side pane of the local TCP ports that listen, with the process name and pid, refreshed every 10 seconds while open. Reads lsof (macOS, most Linux). Open it with /ports.

mods.name: ready
mods.description: Adds /ready: the 20 top ready beads, one line each, and the total. Read with bd, the beads tracker. Read-only. Prints only, copies nothing.

mods.name: receipt
mods.description: Adds /receipt: a shareable receipt of the session (tools, files, commands, blocks, context, cost), printed and copied.

mods.name: recent
mods.description: Adds /recent: your last 15 commits across all local branches (author is git user.name), with branch and date. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: repo-pack
mods.description: Five read-only repo commands in one mod: /todos, /loc, /hotspots, /commit-msg and /branches. They read git. They copy results to the clipboard.

mods.name: say-done
mods.description: On macOS, speaks "Claude is done" with the say command when a turn ends after more than 30 seconds. Does nothing on other platforms.

mods.name: scripts
mods.description: Adds /scripts: runnable tasks from package.json scripts, Makefile targets, justfile recipes and pyproject scripts at the git repo root. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: sha-links
mods.description: Commit SHAs in Claude's replies, and in the output of git commands, become links to the commit page when origin is on GitHub or GitLab. Display only.

mods.name: size
mods.description: Adds /size: the 15 largest tracked files and the total tracked size at HEAD, read with git. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: size-badge
mods.description: Read and Write rows show how much was read or written: the line count, for example 312 lines, or the file size for images and PDFs.

mods.name: sounds-zen
mods.description: Soft bells and singing-bowl tones: a bell when tests pass, a low bowl when they fail, a muted chime when a call is blocked, a bowl when a turn ends.

mods.name: ssh-guard
mods.description: Asks before a private key in .ssh is read, authorized_keys or the SSH config is changed, or ssh-keygen would overwrite a key. Public keys and ssh -i pass. Reads HOME with printenv.

mods.name: standup
mods.description: Adds /standup: Yesterday, Today and Blockers from your git log and this session's record, printed and copied.

mods.name: stashes
mods.description: Adds /stashes: git stashes with their age and the branch each was made on. Read-only, never applies or drops. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: stats-pack
mods.description: The three original stats mods in one: /wrapped (copied to your clipboard), streaks and achievements on one shared daily rollup.

mods.name: ste-mode
mods.description: Replies in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: approved words, short sentences, one instruction each, active voice.

mods.name: streaks
mods.description: Counts consecutive days you used Claude Code: a Day N streak toast at session start, and /streak to ask.

mods.name: sudo-guard
mods.description: Asks before sudo, doas or su -c runs a command with elevated rights.

mods.name: tag-guard
mods.description: Asks before release tags go to a remote: git push --tags, --follow-tags or --mirror, a push of a tag ref, and a push that deletes a remote tag. Dry runs pass. Reads tags with git.

mods.name: tdd-mode
mods.description: Writes a failing test first, watches it fail, then implements.

mods.name: team-pack
mods.description: Team habits in one install: Conventional Commits, test-first work and a security check on every change.

mods.name: terse-mode
mods.description: Short answers: no preamble, no recap.

mods.name: test-pane
mods.description: A live side pane with the last test run (vitest, jest, pytest, go test, cargo test, bun test, claude plugin test): runner, pass, fail and skip counts, duration and first failures. Open it with /tests.

mods.name: time-badge
mods.description: Tool rows show how long the call ran, for example 2.4s, when it took over one second. The time is the tool's own run time, without permission prompts.

mods.name: todo-count
mods.description: A band above the prompt with how many lines in tracked files hold TODO, FIXME or HACK (todo 12), counted with git after edits. Hidden when there are none.

mods.name: todo-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast with the count of TODO, FIXME and HACK lines your edits added this turn. Quiet when none were added.

mods.name: todo-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of the TODO, FIXME and HACK lines in tracked files (git grep), grouped by file and capped at 30. It refreshes after file edits while open. Open it with /todo-pane.

mods.name: todos
mods.description: Adds /todos: TODO, FIXME and HACK lines in tracked files, found with git grep, grouped by file (50 lines at most). Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: tree
mods.description: Adds /tree: tracked files (git ls-files) as a tree, 2 levels deep, folders with file counts (80 lines at most). Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: turn-timer
mods.description: A band above the prompt with how long the current turn has run (turn 0:42). It shows while a turn runs and hides between turns.

mods.name: url-links
mods.description: https links (and http://localhost) in tool output are listed as clickable links under the result, up to five. Display only: Claude reads the output as it was.

mods.name: weekly
mods.description: Adds /week: this week (since Monday) against last week, with sessions, turns, tool calls, files edited and cost, and the change for each.

mods.name: wrapped
mods.description: Adds /wrapped: a screenshot-ready Claude Code Wrapped for the last 7 days (or /wrapped month for 30), printed and copied.

mods.name: yoda-mode
mods.description: Speaks like Yoda in prose. Code, commands and commit messages stay normal.

mods.name: cs-radio
mods.description: Counter-Strike 1.6 radio calls for Claude Code: 'Fire in the hole' on deploys, 'Bomb has been defused' when a long turn lands. /radio to toggle.

mods.name: live-recap
mods.description: A card above the prompt that says what Claude is working on, refreshed every few minutes while a turn runs

mods.name: message-timestamps
mods.description: Prefixes each Claude reply in the transcript with the local time it arrived, with no model calls

mods.name: idle-compact
mods.description: Compacts an idle session just before its prompt cache expires, so returning does not re-write the full context

mods.name: korkmaz-trail
mods.description: An audit trail for your AI agent, above the Claude Code prompt: commands, file changes, outbound calls and risky actions next to your plan limits, context and cost.

mods.name: nyan-cat
mods.description: Nyan Cat flies with its rainbow above the prompt while Claude works. /nyan changes its size or turns it off.

mods.name: bitranox
mods.description: Bitranox skill collection: software-engineering workflow skills (planning, debugging, code review, clean architecture, language and tool references, humanizing) plus a self-improvement loop that captures session learnings into memory and CLAUDE.md, and PostToolUse hooks that validate JSON/YAML/XML…

mods.name: pixel-buddy
mods.description: A pixel Claude critter above the prompt that reacts to typing, working, finishing and going AFK.

mods.name: project-box
mods.description: A folder-tree card beside the status bar listing your projects by category, read from ~/.claude/project-box.json.

mods.name: statusbar
mods.description: Status bar above the prompt: working/idle, tool count, last tool, last turn duration.

mods.name: tristens-tools
mods.description: Tools menu for Claude Code: Clean View, Prompt Upgrade, model/effort control panel, Agent Dock, Roadtrip minigame.

mods.name: agents-panel
mods.description: Side pane listing project, user and plugin agents with a run button each; /agents-panel toggles it.

mods.name: context-bar
mods.description: Context window breakdown and prompt-cache countdown above the prompt; /context-bar toggles it.

mods.description: Helps reduce personal data sent to Claude: redacts detected Thai and international personal data before sending and masks it on screen. mods.name: bostonaholic
mods.description: Matthew Boston's personal Claude Code mods.

mods.name: prototype-mode
mods.description: Flag a project for prototype mode: no git worktrees, iterate and commit directly on the current branch (main included). Works for background jobs too.

mods.name: worktree-terminal
mods.description: Open a terminal in the session's worktree or any agent's worktree: /term, or the buttons above the prompt

mods.name: cockpit
mods.description: Progress bars from your todo list at zero extra tokens, a router where you pick the model and effort for quick, normal and hard prompts, and a prompt-cache meter that can keep the cache warm

mods.name: lens
mods.description: Review a repo's changes in a pane: the changed files with editor-style diagnostics (pyright, ruff, tsc, eslint, terraform), a diff view, a git graph, commits and stashes, and pull request comments. Run /lens [folder] [base].

mods.name: tangents
mods.description: Go off on a tangent about any paragraph of Claude's replies, kept out of the main context until you promote it

mods.name: burnrate
mods.description: Full mod: live limits band above the prompt plus the guard (cache watchdog and limit brake).

mods.name: limit-guard
mods.description: Warns when the prompt cache is invalidated; near the 5h cap blocks subagents and wide scans and asks Claude for short answers.

mods.name: limits-band
mods.description: Band above the prompt: 5h/7d limits with reset timers, context fill, cache hit rate and what fills your context.

mods.name: git-graph
mods.description: A vscode-git-graph style commit graph pane for Claude Code: switch branches, checkout commits, create/rename/delete tags and push them

mods.name: incremental
mods.description: /incremental: the Claude mascot mines a rock for ore; every ore is tokens

mods.name: jev-suite
mods.description: Branch git acima do prompt e juízos do Jev (TypeSafe): guarda de comandos, roteador de esforço, detector de segredos, aviso de agente travado, dica de qualidade do prompt e triagem de saídas

mods.name: status-pills
mods.description: A band of pills above the prompt: model and effort, context, the 5-hour and 7-day limits with their resets, project and branch

mods.name: copy-command
mods.description: An icon-only copy button beside every shell command in Claude's replies.

mods.name: open-link
mods.description: Kitty-style hints mode: label every link in view, press a key to open it in the default browser.

mods.name: pr-watch
mods.description: Above the prompt: the branch PR with its checks and failing log lines, uncommitted work with a commit-and-push key, and how far the branch is behind the default branch with a rebase key. The branch name sits in the hint line.

mods.name: csr-lens
mods.description: Painel ao lado da conversa com visão geral, agentes (quem chamou quem, recados e rodadas), turnos, diffs como no VS Code, árvore de arquivos ao vivo, contexto e custo e inventário de plugins, e uma linha de resumo acima do prompt. mods.description: Draws display LaTeX ($$...$$ or \[...\]) in assistant replies as typeset images (tectonic + kitty graphics)

mods.name: usage-band
mods.description: Context window and subscription-limit usage (5-hour, weekly) above the prompt

mods.description: Spinner verbs that match how smart the current model + effort level is

mods.name: pixel-player
mods.description: A pixel-art music player pane that streams a playlist through mpv

mods.name: context-cache
mods.description: A panel above the prompt showing context usage, usage limits (session, weekly, Fable) and prompt-cache temperature, with Clear, Compact and Warm buttons.

mods.name: deep-space
mods.description: A deep-space themed Claude Code: space verbs, a starfield with a pixel mascot, local Spotify controls and a violet palette.

mods.name: gtm-operator
mods.description: The GTM operator mod for Claude Code: scores every go-to-market draft with its own skill pack's scorer, flags stale and inconsistent drafts across packs, pack dashboards, a guided sprint, analytics, and a guard that keeps brand-config.json and SOUL.md merged.

mods.name: cc-fm-mod
mods.description: claude.fm in your prompt: a live spectrum under the composer and /fm to control the cc-fm player, local or over SSH

mods.name: clima-condor
mods.description: Clima, sol y luna reales, marea, huracanes y relojes en un panel de Claude Code: /clima

mods.name: compound
mods.description: Checks for existing work before a substantial task, and has the lesson written down after a problem is solved.

mods.name: classify-hint
mods.description: Classifies the user's prompt with Haiku against a few yes/no questions in one call and attaches a rough, non-binding hint for the main agent

mods.name: verify-reports
mods.description: Attaches a verification reminder to every delivery from another agent: a subagent's hand-back, a background task's notification, another session's message

mods.name: quick-commands
mods.description: 在模型名右边加一个 ⚡ 按钮，点开面板用点选代替手打斜杠命令，并可直接点选修改 /config 设置；支持中英文界面

mods.name: token-band

mods.name: breadcrumbs
mods.description: An always-on pane with what this session is about: the task, your last prompt, what Claude is doing and last said, and the explanations it wrote, saved as notes you can preview.

mods.name: secrets
mods.description: Hand Claude an API token without it reading the value: you type it into a field above the prompt, Claude uses it in Bash as $NAME, and it is redacted from every tool result.

mods.name: modster-hunter
mods.description: Catch Modsters while you wait for Claude.

mods.name: session-board
mods.description: A floating board of the Claude Code sessions running right now: who works, who waits for you, what was done - and a jump to the tmux window of the one you pick.

mods.name: council
mods.description: Second opinions inside Claude Code: GPT as fresh eyes when you go in circles, Codex acceptance of every handover, and Codex+Claude review of each change.

mods.name: idle-compact
mods.description: Compacts an idle interactive session shortly before its prompt cache expires, so coming back later doesn't re-read the whole context uncached.

mods.name: slash-coverage
mods.description: Which files each Claude Code agent has in its context, and how much of each: line ranges, tokens, re-reads, edits, and which files only a subagent it spawned has read.

mods.name: todos
mods.description: A pane summarising the remaining todos, each with Do, Chat, Defer and Delete

mods.name: cc-pokedex
